deployments_detail.use: FortiAI-Assist / Fortinet Advisor: a generative-AI security assistant embedded across the Security Fabric that guides, simplifies and automates SecOps analyst work (alert triage, incident enrichment, threat investigation, config-script generation). Launched as 'Fortinet Advisor' in Dec 2023 and now GA as FortiAI-Assist. [Fortinet (FortiAI, GenAI); model not publicly disclosed]

FortiGuard AI-powered Security Services: FortiGuard Labs uses AI, ML and deep learning to deliver real-time, proactive threat detection and threat intelligence at machine speed across the attack surface. [Fortinet (FortiGuard AI/ML/deep learning)]

FortiNDR Network Detection and Response: uses purpose-built machine learning and deep neural networks to detect cyberattacks based on anomalous network activity and automate investigation/response. [Fortinet (ML + deep neural networks)]

FortiSandbox / FortiGuard AI-based Inline Malware Prevention Service: AI-powered real-time inspection of files with purpose-built ML to block zero-day and previously unknown file-based threats inline at the gateway. [Fortinet (purpose-built ML/AI sandbox)]

FortiAIOps: AI/ML engine for IT/network operations that collects data, identifies pattern anomalies, and optimizes LAN, Wireless LAN and SD-WAN network management, now with a FortiAI Agent for actionable insights. [Fortinet (AI/ML)]

FortiAIGate: an AI runtime security gateway deployed between applications and LLMs that manages traffic flows and applies guardrails to protect large language models from prompt injection, data leakage and model manipulation. [Fortinet (FortiAIGate); integrated with NVIDIA AI platforms]

FortiSOC: a unified cloud-delivered SOC platform (SIEM + SOAR + threat intel + identity threat detection) powered by agentic AI, with autonomous investigation, AI-generated playbooks, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-powered agent coordination via FortiAI-Assist. [Fortinet (FortiAI-Assist agentic AI, MCP); model not disclosed]

Fortinet + NVIDIA AI Factory security: FortiGate-VM (FortiOS 7.6.3) runs directly on NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPUs, embedding firewalling, segmentation and policy enforcement into AI data-center infrastructure and offloading security inspection from the host. [NVIDIA (BlueField-3 DPU) + Fortinet (FortiOS/FortiGate-VM)]

Vocus Secure Shield with Fortinet: a SASE-delivered service (launched with Australian telco Vocus) that uses Fortinet's deep application awareness and inline DLP to detect shadow-AI usage and flag/block sensitive data before it reaches public LLMs. [Fortinet (FortiSASE/deep app awareness, inline DLP) + Vocus]

FortiEndpoint AI-era expansion: new AI visibility, native DLP/data protection, endpoint risk scoring and FortiAI-Assist delivered through one agent/console/license to let organizations safely adopt AI (data-loss controls for AI use expected Q3 2026). [Fortinet (FortiEndpoint, FortiAI-Assist)]

FortiMail Email Security: multi-layered email protection combining advanced detection engines powered by machine learning (ML) and large language models (LLM) to block phishing, BEC and malware. [Fortinet (ML + LLM)]

FortiWeb Web Application Firewall: AI-based machine-learning function that automatically models and detects malicious web traffic and bots, going beyond signature-based detection. [Fortinet (ML-based anomaly detection)]

Fortinet Security Operations (FortiAI/SecOps) AI-driven detection & response: AI used across the SecOps suite to slash time to detect and contain threats. Fortinet reports triage time reduced from ~8 hours to 10 minutes and containment from 4.2 hours to ~1 minute. [Fortinet (FortiAI/FortiGuard AI/ML)]
deployments_detail.value: Time to triage reduced from 8 hours to 10 minutes; time to contain reduced from 4.2 hours to 1 minute

deployments_detail.use: "FortiAI" + FortiAI-Assist agentic AI across Security Fabric (threat detection, SOC automation, LLM/model protection)
